name: GrillStack — Burger Shop Command Center
description: A burger shop command center: run the order board and kitchen pass, track prep and stock, manage shifts, and reconcile the daily close. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

blocks.title: Kitchen command overview
blocks.body: This report summarises how the shop is trading: how many orders are landing and through which channel, what the kitchen pass is carrying by station, the revenue those orders generate, and where prep stock stands against par. Use it for the weekly ops review and to spot channel or station bottlenecks early.
